tables.name: Farms & Resources
tables.description: Rolled by size (Very Small 1, Small and Medium 2, Large and Very Large 3 rolls). A town with the Farming or Resource Gathering specialty adds 1 and rerolls 1-8: rolled as its d12 variant, the same odds (rerolling a raw 1-8 on the d20, then adding 1).

results.name: None
results.description: If you have any remaining rolls to make on this table, proceed with them. With no farms or resources, how does the town function?

results.name: Farming [Agriculture]
results.description: A group of farms, which provide food, are found on the nearest hospitable land under the town’s control.

results.name: Farming [Livestock]
results.description: A group of farms, which provide livestock, are found on the nearest hospitable land under the town’s control.

results.name: Resource Harvesting
results.description: Depending on the landscape and available resources (trees, minerals, ore, stone, etc.), a logging camp, mine, or quarry belonging to the town has been built nearby to harvest resources for use or sale.

variants.name: Farming or Resource Gathering specialty (+1, reroll 1-8)
